issues.respondent_position: Agreed the deferral challenge is moot (para 1).

issues.issue: Did the PRRA officer unreasonably reject the new letter evidence as not 'new' under s. 113(a)?
issues.applicant_position: Letters showed a continuing, present risk and differed from RPD evidence; officer skipped the new-evidence factors.
issues.result_quote: It was unreasonable to reject the evidence as not new.
